intendedObjective: Reconstruct the naming memo into clear editor instructions.
acceptableEditScope: Remove inflated language and reorganize policy, exceptions, unresolved authorship, and initial checks without expanding them.
stableFactsAndClaims: Uninformative filenames slow excerpt selection; two files named for closing doors also contained preceding footsteps, without becoming unusable.
The policy applies to recordings made from 1 August onward, not mandatory renaming of all old files.
Old files may be renamed when used if the original name is recorded in notes; outside-client deliveries keep delivered names.
New names use coordinator-assigned session code, audible-action description, and take number; editors must not invent alternate codes or name imagined uses.
Location, equipment, and unusual conditions belong in text notes.
Uncertain sounds should be described without asserting a source; possible sources may be identified as possibilities in notes.
Joint-team naming remains unresolved; obtain a coordinator code before uploading, and the coordinator keeps a review list.
The coordinator checks each team's first five uploads for filenames and notes only, not recording quality or the separate pre-client-delivery check.
requiredForm: Clear set of instructions for editors; structure may change.
ambiguity: How to name sessions jointly recorded by two teams remains unsettled.
voiceConstraints: Direct, ordinary instructional language with explicit exceptions and limits.
